meleeDirection: Player/sealer melee must use the actual class weapon from the game catalog. Beast melee follows anatomy. Inspect pose before generating its trail.
readiness: Require generated assets and verified compositing before enabling each pose.

particles.eligibility: Player/sealer always. Beasts only at final form: rare, legendary, solar-eclipse legendary, or ordinary with exactly 3 forms. Ordinary 1-2 forms and earlier forms have no particles. Demon Lord is outside the latest explicit list.

hitReaction.trigger: Resolved attack lands on the target and is not blocked by a protective shield.
hitReaction.decisionSource: Authoritative resolved combat result for each target/hit, not projectile arrival or the presence of a shield buff.
hitReaction.timing: Play target hit pose at the resolved impact beat only.

rangedAttack.synchronizeWith: Existing in-game projectile effects; release starts projectile travel and hit reaction follows the resolved impact.

nonAttackSkill.fallbackWhen: Actor has no authored threat/roar pose.

combatIntegration.classification: Use gameplay skill intent/range, not the visual shape of an effect. A non-damaging debuff remains non-attack even when targeting an enemy.
combatIntegration.availability: Keep existing threat-only art eligibility. Missing threat pose uses windup alone and returns to idle; do not automatically chain into ranged power.
